style: Japanese anime cel-shaded style, two-tone toon shading, crisp clean shapes, saturated colors, game VFX asset, static camera, no camera movement
negative: text, letters, words, watermark, logo, subtitles, camera shake, camera movement, people, hands, realistic photo, blurry

backgrounds.black: centered in frame, isolated on a pure solid black background, nothing else in the scene, no ground, no floor
backgrounds.green: centered in frame, isolated on a pure solid flat chroma-key green (#00FF00) background, nothing else in the scene, no ground, no shadows on the background

spec.note: seconds = length used in game; generate the model's normal length, Claude trims/loops

clips.zh: A1–A5 封印/門打開時疊在門上
clips.prompt: a dark black-purple corrupted glow flickers and goes out, then bursts into a wide spray of bright green light sparks and small green leaves scattering outward and drifting down

clips.zh: A5 每放進一片翠玉碎片
clips.prompt: a glowing jade-green crystal shard snaps into place with a bright green pulse of light, a small ring of green light expanding and fading
a single carved green rune symbol glowing softly, slowly brightening and dimming like breathing
a green rune flashes bright, a flat ring of green light spreads outward along the ground, then a beam of green light shoots off to the right
an ornate ancient bronze key floating in mid-air, slowly rotating and bobbing up and down, tiny warm light motes drifting upward
a sharp crystal shard of glowing jade floating in mid-air, slowly rotating and bobbing, soft green glow, tiny light motes drifting upward
a small glowing object spins fast, shrinks into a bright white star and flies toward the camera
darkness, then a tiny four-pointed golden star glint briefly flashes once and fades, very subtle
darkness, then a faint green glow briefly pulses once inside darkness and fades, very subtle

clips.zh: C1 閃光點（草叢動物眼睛）
clips.prompt: darkness, then a pair of small animal eyes reflect light, blink once and disappear
darkness, then a thin vertical sliver of white light briefly shines through and fades
a tiny glint bursts into a ring of soft white-gold light and a shower of sparkles rising upward
a small cluster of slender herbs with pale blue bioluminescent leaf tips glowing brighter and dimmer like slow breathing, a few firefly-like motes floating around

clips.zh: C4 Boss 倒下後古樹之心浮出
clips.prompt: a heart-shaped seed of living wood wrapped in green light rises upward from below, small new leaves sprouting around it
a heart-shaped seed of living wood wrapped in green light floating in place, pulsing like a heartbeat, leaves slowly orbiting
a green glowing heart-shaped seed dissolves into a stream of green light that flows toward the camera and vanishes

clips.zh: D2 月影湖湖面（貼在湖面上）
clips.prompt: top-down view straight down onto a calm dark jungle lake surface at dusk, moonlight reflections shimmering, a few lily pads drifting slightly, fills the whole frame, no shore, no horizon

clips.zh: D3 篝火的火焰（柴堆是模型）
clips.prompt: flickering orange cartoon campfire flames, rising sparks and thin smoke, flames only, no logs

clips.zh: D4 巨菇林孢子（疊在菇上）
clips.prompt: many small luminous pink and teal spores drifting slowly upward and fading

a small translucent forest spirit made of soft green light, shaped like a child with leaf-like hair and a long wispy tail instead of legs, floating and slowly bobbing, leaves orbiting around it, gentle smile
a bold red exclamation mark pops up with a quick squash-and-stretch bounce, then fades out

clips.zh: E2 會叫同伴的怪物吼叫
clips.prompt: two red sound-wave rings expanding outward from the center and fading
a golden exclamation mark floating, gently bobbing and slowly spinning with a soft glow
a golden question mark floating, gently bobbing and slowly spinning with a soft glow

clips.zh: E4 地名橫幅（只要框，字遊戲自己放）
clips.prompt: a thin ornamental vine-and-leaf frame unfurls horizontally from the center, an empty soft dark-green ribbon with gold edges fades in, holds, then dissolves into drifting leaves, the ribbon is empty with no letters

keyframes.rule: keyframe=start: keyframes/<id>.png 當第一格（loop 的也當最後一格）；keyframe=end: keyframes/<id>_end.png 當最後一格。沒有圖或沒有 keyframe 欄位就用文字生影片。
